stable_traits.personality: Commanding, secretive, and powerful. Prioritizes her mission and does not explain herself unless necessary. Confident in her use of the One Power.

characters.notes: Already on roster. Shows clear emotional distress about Egwene learning to channel.

stable_traits.personality: Greedy, suspicious, and fearful. Willing to profit from strangers but afraid of supernatural threats. Described as someone who might 'sell his mother to Trollocs for stew meat if the price was right.'

stable_traits.personality: Grumbles and complains about discomfort. Curious but nervous, particularly about the Aes Sedai's power.

characters.notes: Already on roster. Questions Moiraine about the ferry's destruction.

stable_traits.personality: Deliberate and steady. Hopes for rest.

characters.notes: Already on roster. Carries his great axe prominently in this chapter.

stable_traits.personality: Theatrical and skilled. Shows concern for practical matters like extending the fog protection. Knowledgeable about Aes Sedai and wary of them.

characters.notes: Matches roster entry 'The Gleeman'. Now identified with full name Thom Merrilin. Demonstrates juggling knife trick to intimidate ferry crew.

stable_traits.personality: Eager for adventure and learning. Enthusiastic and forward-leaning toward new experiences. Strong-willed and excited by the prospect of becoming Aes Sedai.

characters.notes: Already on roster. Discovers she can channel and is overjoyed at the prospect of becoming Aes Sedai. Successfully channels light through a blue stone with Moiraine's guidance.

Already on roster. Egwene leans against Bela when tired.

appearances.whereabouts: Leading the party through Taren Ferry, across the river, and to a hidden campsite in the woods
appearances.notable_actions: Guides the party through fog to the ferry. Displays his sword openly to intimidate Hightower. Negotiates and pays the ferryman. Had pre-prepared a hidden campsite under fallen trees. Tends to the horses and prepares tea. Explains the effects of Moiraine's Power on the horses and advises careful travel.
appearances.demeanor: Alert, competent, and prepared. Like 'a metal spring, compressed, waiting.' Protective and strategic.

appearances.whereabouts: Leading the party from Taren Ferry across the river to a hidden camp, where she teaches Egwene
appearances.notable_actions: Uses the One Power to create an extensive fog along the river to hide their crossing and confuse pursuit. Destroys the ferry with a whirlpool to prevent followers. Pays Hightower generously with gold. Explains her strategy regarding the Draghkar and Myrddraal. Teaches Egwene about the True Source, saidin, saidar, and channeling. Guides Egwene through her first successful channeling of the One Power.
appearances.demeanor: Commanding and authoritative, sometimes seeming to loom over others. Secretive about her methods. Patient and gentle when teaching Egwene. Satisfied with Egwene's success.

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with the party from Taren Ferry across the river to the hidden camp
appearances.notable_actions: Follows Lan's instructions, displaying his sword to intimidate the ferry crew. Nearly walks off the ferry landing in the fog. Leads Cloud carefully. Questions Lan about Hightower and Darkfriends. Watches Moiraine teach Egwene with growing distress. Jumps up when Egwene asks about becoming an Aes Sedai, hitting his head, and is restrained by Thom. Desperately hopes Egwene will fail to channel.
appearances.demeanor: Nervous, sore from riding, and conflicted. Anxious about the ferry and Darkfriends. Deeply distressed about Egwene learning to channel, showing jealousy or fear of losing her.

appearances.whereabouts: Operating the ferry across the Taren River, then fleeing upriver after the ferry's destruction
appearances.notable_actions: Leads the party and his crew across the river in thick fog. Constantly peers nervously into the fog, worried about threats. Demands payment and reminds them the first gold is hidden. Accepts additional gold and silver for his crew. Witnesses the ferry break apart in a whirlpool. After initial shock, accepts more gold from Lan and flees in terror with his crew.
appearances.demeanor: Suspicious, greedy, and fearful. Nervous throughout the crossing. Terrified after the ferry's destruction.

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with the party across the Taren and to the hidden camp
appearances.notable_actions: Grumbles about the cold and fog. Shows his bow and quiver to intimidate the ferry crew. Announces the Taren is not as wide as rumored. Questions Moiraine about the ferry's destruction but trails off weakly. Stares openly at Moiraine teaching Egwene.
appearances.demeanor: Grumbling and uncomfortable. Nervous about the Aes Sedai's power. Curious but intimidated.

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with the party across the Taren and to the hidden camp
appearances.notable_actions: Grumbles about discomfort. Displays his great axe openly on the ferry. Plants his feet deliberately and eases his axe in its loop to intimidate the ferry crew. Has difficulty getting a feedbag on his horse. Hopefully asks if they can rest. Stares openly at Moiraine teaching Egwene.
appearances.demeanor: Tired, sore, and grumbling. Hopeful for rest. Uncomfortable about discussion of male channelers and the Red Ajah.

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with the party across the Taren and to the hidden camp
appearances.notable_actions: Grumbles about wanting hot food and mulled wine. Performs a theatrical flourish with a dagger, making it appear and twirl between his fingers to intimidate the ferry crew. Questions Moiraine about why she didn't extend the fog toward Baerlon, then apologizes diffidently. Physically restrains Rand when he jumps up during Egwene's lesson, warning him it's beyond his control. Growls when Moiraine mentions the Red Ajah gentling male channelers. Pretends to focus on his pipe while listening to the lesson.
appearances.demeanor: Theatrical and performative. Practical and questioning of strategy. Sympathetic to Rand's distress. Wary of Aes Sedai, particularly the Red Ajah.

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling with the party across the Taren and to the hidden camp, where she receives instruction from Moiraine
appearances.notable_actions: Marches with her back straight and head high despite discomfort. Claps at Thom's dagger trick. Slumps tiredly against Bela. Learns about the True Source and channeling from Moiraine. Successfully channels light through a blue stone with Moiraine's guidance. Embraces Moiraine in joy when told she can become Aes Sedai. Excitedly tells Rand she's going to be an Aes Sedai.
appearances.demeanor: Eager and excited about the adventure. Increasingly tired but maintains composure. Enthusiastic and forward-leaning during instruction. Overjoyed at discovering she can channel.

appearances.whereabouts: With Rand, crossing the river and moving to the hidden camp
appearances.notable_actions: Carried by Rand across the ferry. Tosses head before accepting feedbag. Affected by Moiraine's Power - will run at fastest speed until dropping dead if not carefully managed.
appearances.demeanor: Restless and affected by magical enhancement

appearances.whereabouts: With the party, crossing the river and moving to the hidden camp
appearances.notable_actions: Egwene slumps against Bela when tired. Affected by Moiraine's Power like the other horses.

relationships.description: Moiraine is the Aes Sedai who holds Lan's Warder bond. They work in close coordination throughout the chapter.
Moiraine teaches Egwene about channeling and the One Power, guiding her through her first successful use of the Power.
Rand is deeply distressed when Egwene shows ability to channel and excitement about becoming Aes Sedai. Thom sympathizes with Rand about losing her, suggesting romantic feelings.
Thom restrains Rand and offers sympathetic advice when Rand reacts to Egwene's channeling, showing a protective mentorship.
Transactional relationship. Lan negotiates passage and payment with Hightower, displaying his sword as subtle threat.
Rand owns and rides Cloud, caring for the horse throughout the journey.
Egwene rides and relies on Bela, leaning against the horse when tired.
